items.q: Jimmy McPhail -- Jimmy McPhail worked also with the band.

ctx.x: Jimmy McPhail -- Jimmy McPhail worked also with the band. First time I saw him, he came to Vegas or what's that other town out of Vegas -- Tahoe -- and worked, and then he was with the band for quite a while. He has a bar in Washington, doing quite well.
Yeah, he worked for (unintelligible) -- in 'My Peo
